text: The Lodh Falls (also known as Budha Ghagh) is a waterfall on the Burha River in the mid-forest  of Palamau Tiger Reserve, in Latehar district of Jharkhand state in India. It is the highest waterfall in Jharkhand and the 21st highest waterfall in India.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
